ac.item: AC-1: assign user to zone, no error toast, saves
ac.evidence: Browser lane A1: logged in as admin (id 3), assigned kit driver (id 4) to the zero-driver zone 'QA — Zone DEV-2291' and saved — green 'Zone saved' toast, NO 'Error while loading page' toast; the livewire/update POST that fires the real synchronous Pusher broadcast returned 200.

ac.item: AC-2: assignment persists when broadcast fails
ac.evidence: Live: A2 confirmed the driver chip persists under 'Assigned Kit Users' after a full reload. Failure-path persistence (broadcast throws → save still persists) is proven deterministically by the automated feature test test_save_persists_the_zone_and_assignment_when_broadcasting_throws (throwing broadcaster; zone + zone_user assert persisted).

ac.item: AC-3: genuine data error still rolls back
ac.evidence: Not browser-checkable. Verified by the automated suite: the existing test_save_rolls_back_and_does_not_broadcast_when_geometry_rebuild_fails still passes unchanged, so a genuine in-transaction data error still rolls back (the fix isolates only the broadcast dispatch).

Mechanism confirmed by B2 (both events implement Illuminate\Contracts\Broadcasting\ShouldRescue → BroadcastManager wraps the dispatch in rescue()->report()). The automated test asserts the failure is report()'d (Exceptions::assertReported). No live broadcast failure occurred this run (the sync broadcast to wss.insightlpr.io succeeded — the log shows no broadcast/Pusher exception), so there was nothing to surface; the save succeeded silently with the success toast.
